issues.title: On first login, messages appear to get sent twice
issues.body:
When we first login, any messages we send appear in the channel twice.

If we refresh the page, the messages are only displayed once, and we see that the issue is in rendering, rather than the message getting sent twice (since we see there is now only one copy).

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/d240ad4c51322f3851935f45a23dbb90.gif)

Note, I've looked at the network tab in Dev tools. It shows that we've registered twice to listen for `_changes`:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/123454022-021c6680-d5d8-11eb-957e-9bd3f428ae0d.png)

If I refresh the page, then we only register once for `_changes:`:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/123454158-27a97000-d5d8-11eb-963e-7265e3aaa198.png)

comments.body:
_Hopefully_ fixed in #897 

Will reopen if it fails test.

Aah, the fix here has had an impact.

The fix removed a listener.  But now, when a game first loads, it does not hear new messages.   Once the page has been refreshed, the listener works.

Note: this issue is difficult to reproduce.  It certainly happens - including reports from users who are not seeing new messages.  But, after an F5 refresh it is difficult to make the issue occur

Steps to reproduce:
* Open this Serge instance: https://serge-review.herokuapp.com
* Click `Play` button
* Open game titled `CmdWk - High Data`
* Login as `White-Game Control`
* Create message in `BLUE RFI` channel
* Senf message
* Note that message is not displayed.  
* Press F5 (refresh)
* Note that message is displayed
* Also note that new sent messages are now displayed
Fixed. We now always receive updates, and don't get any duplication.
